edits.prompt:
Edit this existing Chinese FT PD diagram. Preserve all boxes, all text, colors, overall arrangement, resolution and typography. Correct arrow semantics only.
CRITICAL FIX: Remove the orange dashed arrow from “TP / Attention DP/EP 计算组（GPU）” to “本地完成事件（各 rank）”. Transfer completion events MUST originate at “传输后端：CUDA IPC + 异步拷贝”, NOT from the computation group. Draw a clearly labelled orange dashed control line from the transfer backend to the local completion events box, label “异步拷贝实际完成”. Route this line through available whitespace; if necessary move only the event box and nearby background-thread chain slightly to create a clean route. Never let the line appear to originate in or pass through the compute-group box. The chain remains transfer backend → local completion events → CPU background thread → notification queue → scheduler.
Change the arrow “就绪后提交计算” from scheduler to computation group to ORANGE DASHED because it is a compute command, not KV data. Change the capacity-note→waiting-queue arrow to ORANGE DASHED.
In the two bottom lifecycle strips, make the sequence arrows ORANGE DASHED for state progression, not blue data arrows. Keep blue solid arrows exclusively for the P KV pool → transfer backend → D local KV pool and D local KV pool → compute group actual data access. Keep the green notification arrows as they are. Do not change any other content. Check that no completion-event arrow depends on D computation starting; readiness must be established before D computes.

diagrams.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a precise Chinese engineering architecture diagram, first of a coordinated series of four diagrams about the planned FT single-host prefill/decode disaggregation system. This is a bitmap image for a Chinese engineer, not a poster or marketing illustration. Landscape 16:10, very high resolution, white background, navy typography, large readable Chinese text, rounded rectangular containers, clean thin outlines, generous whitespace, orthogonal arrows, minimal icons. Text must be clear and correct. Consistent palette: orange dashed arrows for request/control/meta, blue thick arrows for actual KV movement, green arrows for generated Token output. Purple dashed arrow only for optional reverse KV reuse. Use exactly the labels below; do not add unrelated protocols or claims about completed implementation.
Title: “图 1｜FT PD 分离总体架构”
Subtitle: “单机设计方案 · 尚未实现”
At top center a client box: “调用方 / 业务后端”, small text “每轮携带所需对话历史”.
Below it a wide central box “Router / 统一入口（CPU）”. Three simple lines inside: “选择 P、D 服务 · 建立请求配对”, “转交 meta · 健康检查 · 有条件重试”, “持有客户端连接 · 统一输出”. Show orange request arrow from client to Router and separate green result arrow from Router to client. Do NOT draw a client link to any P or D service.
Below Router, two equal side-by-side large pools: left “P 服务池：P0 … P(M−1)” and right “D 服务池：D0 … D(N−1)”. Router has separate orange downward request arrows to each pool, plus P->Router orange “状态 / 来源 meta” and D->Router green “全部输出 Token”. Indicate these are overall connectivity, not execution order: short tiny caption “请求分发时序见图 2”.
Inside EACH pool draw two stacked example service cards and an ellipsis to indicate independent services. Each service card contains three clearly separated bands: “服务内 DP 选择与调度（CPU）”; “GPU 计算 + 本地 KV 池”; “独立 KV 交接模块”. For P GPU band say “Prompt Prefill · 不采样输出”; for D GPU band say “重算 Prompt 末 Token · 生成全部输出”. No sample Token produced by P. Two side notes below pools: “单个服务可选 DP×TP 或 Attention DP/EP” and “内部多副本路由默认 load；TP/EP 仍按组推进”.
Between selected P and D service's KV handoff modules draw a bold BLUE left-to-right arrow “P → D：推送 / 拉取”. This arrow must directly connect the service modules, never enter Router. Beneath it draw a PURPLE dashed arrow from D back to P labelled “D → P：可选历史 KV 拉取（图 4）”. If there is limited horizontal space use a distinct bottom horizontal data lane with connectors, never misleading arrow directions.
Bottom pale-blue banner: “单机数据通道：CUDA IPC + 异步 GPU 间拷贝”
Then three concise small labels: “Router 默认 cache_aware；P / D 可分别配置” · “PD 通道与 TP/EP 通信隔离” · “不支持 PP”
Bottom legend with orange dashed “请求 / 控制 / meta”, blue solid “KV 数据”, green solid “Token 输出”.
Prominent final callout: “Router 不搬运 KV；P、D 各自持有模型权重与 KV 池”.
Avoid excessive text, overlapping connections, crosses, tiny illegible labels, claim all services share a single model weight copy, imply P generates first output, or show KV going through Router.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a precise Chinese engineering infographic, second of four coordinated FT PD design diagrams. Landscape 16:10, white background, navy large readable typography, pastel orange control and blue data, green output, rounded boxes, plenty of spacing. High-resolution technical documentation image. Title “图 2｜一次请求怎样完成 KV 交接”. Subtitle “推送与拉取由谁发起，以及短 / 长 Prompt 的传输时机”. Design two upper swimlane panels side by side and one full-width lower panel. Orange dashed arrows are control/meta, blue solid arrows are actual KV data. Arrow directions must be correct, especially READ initiator vs data direction.
Upper left panel title “短 Prompt · 拉取（D 发起 READ）”. Three vertical swimlanes left-to-right Router, P, D. Time downward. 1 orange Router→P labelled “① 请求 + 交接编号”; P activity “② 完成全部 Prefill，保留 KV”. 3 orange P→Router “③ 来源 meta”; 4 orange Router→D “④ 原始请求 + 来源 meta”. D activity “⑤ 分配接收空间”. Show orange D→P READ request arrow “⑥ D 发起 READ” and separate blue P→D data arrow “KV 数据”. D final activity “⑦ 所需 KV 全部可用 → 开始生成”. Orange P meta must be AFTER P complete, and D allocation after request delivered.
Upper right panel title “短 Prompt · 推送（P 发起 WRITE）”. Three swimlanes Router, P, D. First orange Router request branches to both P and D with “① 同一请求 + 交接编号”. Parallel activities: P “② 计算 Prefill”, D “② 分配接收空间”. Orange D→P arrow “③ 登记目标 meta”. Join-condition small box at P: “Prefill 完成 + 目标已登记”. Blue P→D arrow “④ P 发起 WRITE，传 KV”. D final box “⑤ 写入实际完成 → 开始生成”. Explicit footnote “P 先算完或 D 先分配好，两种顺序都支持”. Do not show D readiness as a mandatory gate BEFORE P starts computing.
Lower panel title “长 Prompt · 逐层传输（默认 ≥ 512 Token）”. Compact flow: “Router 提前分发给 P、D” branching into P “P 计算各层 KV” and D “D 分配接收空间”. A four-step horizontal strip shows “第 1 层 KV 就绪 → 传第 1 层” and “同时计算后续层”, then “后续层依次就绪、传输”. Add concise two-line explicit distinction “拉取：来源 meta 经 Router 转交；层就绪后 D READ” and “推送：D 直接登记目标；层就绪后 P WRITE”. Small warning badge “位置已知 ≠ 数据已就绪”.
At bottom a full-width green ending: “全部所需 KV + 原始请求就绪 → D 重算 Prompt 末 Token → D 生成首个及后续 Token → Router → 调用方”.
Bottom two small notes: “< 512 Token：全部算完再传；阈值可配置” and “D 空间不足：本地排队；P 保留已算 KV，空间就绪后补传”.
Footer legend orange control/meta blue KV green generated results. All KV BLUE arrows point P→D regardless of READ or WRITE. P never samples output. Single-layer completion must not imply D generation can start. Numbers clearly readable, no erroneous duplicate source arrow, no extra words.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a precise Chinese technical architecture diagram, third in a set about planned FT PD disaggregation. White background, landscape 16:10, high resolution, navy clear Chinese typography, balanced spacing, rounded rectangular modules. Orange dashed control arrows, blue solid KV data arrows, green notification-ready/output arrows. Title “图 3｜服务内部：调度、交接与资源生命周期”. Subtitle “以 D 接收为例；P 复用同一套交接机制”. Upper main diagram has a large D-service boundary, with “P 的 KV 池” outside on the left.
Inside D boundary, left-to-right across top show “请求等待队列” → “服务内部调度器（CPU）” → “TP / Attention DP/EP 计算组（GPU）”. Scheduler→compute arrow label “就绪后提交计算”. Under request scheduler note “DP 选目标；TP/EP 按共同顺序执行”. There is no direct background-worker arrow to GPU computation.
Under scheduler a box “独立 KV 交接模块”, with four short responsibility pills “校验身份与范围”, “分片映射 / 布局适配”, “准备接收空间”, “维护请求级交接记录”. Under that, connected with clear control arrows, a box “传输后端：CUDA IPC + 异步拷贝”. A blue solid data path comes from external P KV pool into D's “本地 KV 池（GPU）”; put transport backend along this path logically but no CPU data relay: label “GPU 之间直接搬运 KV”. D compute accesses this local KV pool.
On the right lower side draw a vertical control chain “本地完成事件（各 rank）” → “CPU 后台线程：跟踪任务、汇总完成” → “通知队列：就绪 / 失败 / 取消完成” → back into scheduler. Completion events originate from actual asynchronous transfer, not merely submission. Add a readiness gate note between background thread and notify: “所需范围 + 分片 + 相关 rank 全部完成”. Label GPU read dependency “数据就绪后才能计算”.
A small side box next to request queue: “容量不足 → 继续排队” and “D 准入：每活跃请求默认 512 Token 增长预算”. A brief note “预算不等于提前分配 512 Token 页面”.
Below main architecture, put two independent horizontal lifecycle rows:
1 normal row with four rounded boxes “提交传输” → “跟踪实际完成” → “接收可用，通知调度器” → “D 安排首步及后续计算”. Label above “提交成功 ≠ 传输完成”.
2 cancellation row, orange highlight “取消 / 超时 / 失败” → “停止后续提交” → “等待在途访问结束” → “解除本次占用”. Add small text “仍被其他请求或缓存引用的 KV 继续保留”.
Bottom bold blue banner “回收的是请求 / 传输占用，不是释放整个 KV 池”.
Bottom footnote “P 空间不足也在本地排队；源端可解除占用与 D 接收就绪分别判断”.
Make all arrows logically precise. Do not imply scheduler blocks waiting for transfer, do not let background thread enter TP/EP collective independently, do not imply all P source KV must wait until D starts generation to unpin, do not show CPU staging memory.

Use case: infographic-diagram.
Redraw the referenced Chinese engineering diagram completely with a much cleaner layout. The reference is the old, cluttered diagram. Preserve the technical meaning, but DO NOT preserve its box layout, return loops, icons, redundant details, or overlapping arrows. Produce ONE polished, highly legible Chinese diagram, landscape approximately 4:3, white background, dark navy text, subtle pale blue sections, large readable Chinese type. Minimal flat boxes, no gradients or 3D art. Large whitespace. Topic is a planned design, not implemented functionality.

Title exactly: “图 4｜多轮 KV 复用”
Subtitle exactly: “下一轮 P 按需拉取上一轮 D 的 KV”
Small top-right tag: “设计方案 · 回传开启时”
Small simple legend: orange dashed = “请求 / meta”; blue solid = “KV 数据”; green solid = “Token 输出”.

Use two clearly separated numbered sections, followed by a small output strip and two text notes.

SECTION 1 (upper 20% of canvas), heading “① 上一轮结束：保留 KV，登记来源”.
Draw ONLY TWO boxes on one horizontal row, with ample space between:
Left box “上一轮 D”, with two short lines underneath inside the box: “解码完成后保留有效 KV”, “默认 480 秒，可配置”.
Right box “Router”, line inside “记录会话对应的 KV 来源”.
ONE ORANGE dashed arrow from left box to right box labelled “来源 meta：位置、有效范围、有效期”.
Below this section small note: “480 秒从解码结束后开始，不限制解码时长。”
Do NOT include the previous round's P, caller, Token output or extra storage cylinder.

SECTION 2 (middle 55–60%), heading “② 下一轮到来：先准备空间，再拉取”.
Use a SIMPLE SEQUENCE DIAGRAM with FOUR fixed columns left to right:
“调用方” | “Router” | “本轮 P” | “上一轮 D”.
Draw thin light gray vertical lifelines; time flows DOWN, indicated by a small “时间 ↓” at far left.
All message arrows are HORIZONTAL at DISTINCT heights, with clear arrowheads and NO looping paths. Every arrow endpoint is exactly on the correct lifeline; lines crossing an intermediate lifeline are not junctions.
Rows in exact order:
1. ORANGE dashed from 调用方 to Router: “1  历史消息 + 新问题”.
2. ORANGE dashed from Router to 本轮 P: “2  请求 + 上轮来源 meta”.
3. At 本轮 P lifeline, a small rectangular operation box: “校验并复用本地前缀 / 为缺失 KV 分配接收空间”. Use two lines; no outgoing arrow from this operation box besides continuing the lifeline.
4. ORANGE dashed from 本轮 P to 上一轮 D: “3  P 发起 READ”.
5. BLUE thick arrow from 上一轮 D LEFTWARDS to 本轮 P: “4  历史 KV 直接传输”.
6. At 本轮 P lifeline, a small operation box: “5  KV 就绪后 / 计算剩余历史与新增输入”.
Leave Router and caller lifelines unused during READ/KV rows: KV MUST NEVER go to Router.
A small calm caption underneath: “本轮可以换 P；Router 只转交 meta，KV 在 D 与 P 之间直接传输。”
No additional state machine, polling box, backend implementation, cancellation arrows, or storage icons.

BOTTOM OUTPUT STRIP (about 10%), heading “后续生成：沿用 P→D 交接流程”.
Four SMALL boxes in a straight left-to-right row, independent from the sequence-diagram columns:
“本轮 P” —BLUE right arrow labelled “KV”→ “本轮 D” —GREEN right arrow labelled “Token”→ “Router” —GREEN right arrow labelled “统一输出”→ “调用方”.
Below 本轮 D within its box add “生成全部输出”.
Do NOT route any output directly from D to caller. P does NOT sample or generate output Tokens.

FOOTER NOTES (no arrows, just two concise side-by-side lines):
“P 空间不足：在 P 调度队列等待。”
“旧 KV 缺失或过期：P 按请求中的历史重算。”

Critical visual requirements:
- No line crosses through a text box.
- No long U-shaped perimeter loops.
- No duplicate decorative storage boxes.
- No unnecessary failure/cancellation branches.
- Keep 480 seconds and all directions correct.
- READ control goes P -> old D; actual historical KV goes old D -> P.
- Present the main success flow cleanly. Omitted details remain in the written design, do not add them back.
- Perfectly legible Chinese with ample line height; lean toward fewer labels rather than dense typography.
